d: TIDEBOUND #2 — The Oath Light. Samaraia hurries toward open water past Gullrest, deep listening flaring. Starring Samaraia (Sesor Shacott), Ilselor (Pabris Esor), Olmarae (Belsor Galcott), Kaanethe (Oven Kavex). Harbor kids and old sailors bound by tide-oaths guard the sea-roads between Gullrest and the drowned places.
